Facility Inventory & Condition Assessmen.justification: Comprehensive district-wide inventory including building sizes, ages, classrooms, portables, and specialized spaces; detailed condition assessments covering HVAC, plumbing, roofs, electrical, lighting, technology infrastructure, and accessibility; connects condition data to student outcomes and integrates short- and long-term capital planning (e.g., Evergreen ES detailed assessments, multiple site plans, and condition ratings).

Enrollment & Capacity Planning.justification: Provides comprehensive enrollment projections with methodology (demographic trends, housing development) through 2028-29 and beyond; detailed capacity utilization data by site and classroom; explicit strategies for right-sizing schools, replacing portables, and flexible space use; connects enrollment to facility actions district-wide (e.g., capacity summaries and planning for each school).

Educational Alignment.justification: Educational alignment is a core organizing principle with detailed educational specifications; clear integration of district mission, instructional priorities, and facilities planning; projects directly respond to educational needs including TK, CTE, STEAM, special education, wellness centers, and collaborative learning spaces (e.g., detailed IoQ scoring linking projects to educational programs).

Outdoor Spaces & Greening.justification: District-wide data and analysis on outdoor spaces including shade structures, permeable surfaces, and green spaces; detailed strategies for campus greening such as expanded tree cover, rain gardens, bioswales, and outdoor classrooms; frames greening as climate resilience and wellness strategy; includes outdoor learning and community benefits (e.g., multiple schools with shade structures, walking paths, field improvements, and outdoor learning areas).

Climate Risk & Mitigation.justification: Plan addresses multiple climate risks with detailed strategies such as perimeter fencing, shade structures, stormwater management, and improved HVAC; climate readiness is a theme in the plan and integrated into site-level projects and long-range planning; however, comprehensive district-wide climate risk assessment for multiple impacts is implied but not fully detailed across all sites.

Energy Efficiency & Resilience.justification: Includes energy efficiency strategies such as solar panel arrays, LED lighting, HVAC upgrades, and some renewable energy integration; discusses energy resilience goals with backup power and microgrids mentioned; references state requirements like Title 24 and Zero Net Energy goals but lacks fully comprehensive district-wide energy data and detailed electrification plans.

Financial Plan & Capital Strategy.justification: Provides itemized cost estimates with some methodology, prioritization framework based on Indicators of Quality, and identifies funding sources including bonds and state grants; includes project cost contingencies and phased implementation; lacks fully detailed long-term financial sustainability analysis and comprehensive capital improvement plan.
